name: PDA Society
description: UK charity focused on information, support, training and research around the profile commonly called pathological or pervasive demand avoidance (PDA).
intended_use: Inspect a specialist UK organisation's current information and support routes when someone is exploring demand-avoidance experiences or the PDA label.
audience_or_context: People identifying with PDA, families, carers and professionals who need to understand the organisation's framing and available support.
limitations: PDA is a debated construct and is not a standalone diagnosis in major diagnostic manuals; different clinicians and autistic people use the label differently.
The Society's framing is one stakeholder perspective and should not be treated as settled diagnostic consensus.
cost_or_access_notes: Public information is available online; some training, membership or other services may have fees or eligibility conditions.
conflicts_of_interest: PDA Society exists specifically to advocate, research and provide support around PDA; that mission creates a clear perspective interest which ND Oracle keeps visible.

provenance.method: Current first-party identity, access route and stated function checked on 2026-08-28. Listing records what the resource is and how to reach it without adopting provider claims of benefit.
